description: This bar chart illustrates the “effect” values for different linguistic “tag” categories across multiple model and language configurations. The horizontal axis represents the categories – “case”, “gender”, “tag”, “number”, and “tense” – listed in that order, and is labeled “tag”. The vertical axis, labeled “effect”, displays values ranging from 0 to 20 with a linear scale and tick marks at 5-unit intervals.  There are four sets of bars for each category, representing the models mBERT-L₂ (light beige), XLM-L₂ (light blue), mBERT-R₂ (light green), and XLM-R₂ (light red). Each set consists of a single bar with error bars indicating variability; for the “case” category, the mBERT-L₂ bar has a value of approximately 6, while the XLM-R₂ bar reaches approximately 12. The bars are not sorted by any apparent order. All bars have error bars extending above and below, indicating a range of values, and no bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
